meta_description: Guides for running your own VPN server with VpnHood! SERVER: install it on Linux or in Docker, managed or standalone, and keep its IP from being blocked.
title: VpnHood! SERVER documentation
lead: A managed server is run from VpnHood! MANAGER, the web panel that balances users across your servers: see the VpnHood! MANAGER documentation. A standalone server runs from its own settings file, and these pages show how.
